preregistered.observable: per block and iteration, a = (samples with exactly one click in the block's slot that land on an algebra mode) / (samples with exactly one click in the slot), the observable of scripts/qd_packed_mode_swap_analysis.py
preregistered.binding: a result iteration binds to its setting by circuit_params and compilation_seed; the two repeats of one layout share both and bind in submission order
preregistered.mesh_identity: the sha256 of each returned computed_circuit; the two repeats of a layout requested one mesh, and a repeat pair with different digests leaves its drift statistic descriptive
preregistered.drift: per block and layout, z = (a_repeat1 - a_repeat0) / two-sample se; D = sum z^2 over blocks and layouts of mesh-identical pairs against chi-square with that many degrees of freedom; drift detected when p < 0.01
preregistered.placement: per block, z = (a_swapped - a_packed) / se on the pooled repeats; a block moved when |z| > 4.5
preregistered.slot_predictor: decide() of scripts/qd_packed_mode_swap_analysis.py on the pooled packed and swapped shares: verdict block, slot, mixed or undetermined
preregistered.interpretation: placement against drift for the residual of the packed box-kite series; a moved block with no drift places the residual on the chip modes
